text_block_list.text: One day, I head to the training course…

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
We'll be resuming our cover story right 
after the break.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Thanks! I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
*sigh* If you keep staring at me like 
that, I'll get tired.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: …Right, Scarlet?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
…Oh, dear. You're in a good mood. You look 
like you're about to lose your cool.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
If we were rivals like this, we wouldn't 
have had to wait and see. We'd have won 
the next race.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: *sigh* You never change.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmph… I'll give you one piece of advice. 
Don't regret saying something so bad, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
An interview is a record. It's very 
different from shouting at the riverbank.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Haha, stupid.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's because it's on record that you say 
cool things. Just follow my heart.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: …I feel like a fool.

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text: Vodka, please stand by.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Oh! I'm coming!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: …Heheh, just you wait.

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Now, before I take a picture of her 
running…

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Vodka. You're the most expected of this 
term, and you're still active…

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text: Can you say something?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Of course! I've decided what to say.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
…I'll win any race! And I'll redo the 
highest GI record!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I think I'll do everything I can to get 
the most excited, so watch!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
…Do you intend to surpass even Chairman 
Rudolf's record?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Of course. But if you want to doubt my 
resolve…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Tell me when you see me running.
And vodka starts running――

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: Wow…! Wow, that's amazing…!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
You're right! I'm looking forward to the 
race!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
…What a wonderful girl. If it's her, then 
her words from before will be realized in 
the future…!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Heehee… I'm so glad I got permission to 
cover the next issue! I'll get in touch 
with the editor-in-chief and do a special 
feature on the next month!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: …Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
…You seem to be doing well. I'll 
definitely win the next race!
